metadata.title: AegisAI — Production AI Knowledge Workspace
metadata.description: Document ingestion, hybrid retrieval, grounded RAG chat, policy-gated agents, evaluation and observability — one calm workspace.

common.notImplemented: Not wired to the backend yet

landing.badge: Self-hosted · Deny-by-default · Built to be audited
landing.subtitle: AegisAI ingests your files, indexes them for hybrid search, and answers questions with citations — behind a policy gate that records every decision.
landing.pipelineDesc: Every request travels the same guarded path — nothing reaches an action without passing the gate.

gateway.name: Gateway
gateway.desc: FastAPI with JWT auth, RBAC and rate limiting. Every call carries a trace id.

context.name: Context
context.desc: Conversation history plus retrieved, citation-ready passages from Qdrant.

reasoning.name: Reasoning
reasoning.desc: OpenAI-compatible LLMs or a local llama.cpp server — one provider abstraction.

policy.name: Policy gate
policy.desc: Deny by default. Role, allowlist and constraints checked; every verdict audited.

execution.name: Guarded execution
execution.desc: Actions run from a strict registry of typed tools — no free-form execution.

verify.name: Verify
verify.desc: Schema and business-rule validation with retry-and-feedback repair loops.

observe.name: Observe
observe.desc: Langfuse traces, golden-dataset evaluations, quality gates in CI.

ingest.name: Document ingestion
ingest.desc: Upload PDF, DOCX, Markdown or text — extraction, chunking and embedding run through a Celery worker.

chat.name: Streaming RAG chat
chat.desc: Token-by-token SSE answers with a trace id on every response, so anything you read can be traced.

searchReady.name: Hybrid index
searchReady.desc: Dense + sparse vectors in a single Qdrant collection with RRF fusion — search UX lands next.

auth.name: Auth & RBAC
auth.desc: Access/refresh JWT rotation, admin/user/agent roles, per-route dependencies.

policy.name: Policy audit trail
policy.desc: An immutable table records every allow/deny with actor, action and reason.

local.name: Local-first models
local.desc: Run quantized GGUF models on 4GB of VRAM, or point at any OpenAI-compatible API.

landing.roadmapDesc: Built one verified phase at a time — checkmarks follow passing tests, not intentions.

p1.title: Gateway & security
p1.desc: DB, users, JWT, RBAC, rate limits

p4.desc: Context builder, action registry, policy gate, verifier

p5.title: Agentic runtime
p5.desc: LangGraph loops, MCP tools, human-in-the-loop approvals

p6.title: Evaluation
p6.desc: Faithfulness & recall metrics, quality gates in CI

coming.title: This page is being built
coming.subtitleSearch: Dense + sparse hybrid retrieval with RRF fusion and cross-encoder reranking will live here.
coming.subtitleApprovals: Human-in-the-loop approvals for agent proposals — pause the graph, decide, and the run resumes with a full audit trail.
coming.subtitleAudit: Every policy decision, allow or deny, will be listed here with actor, action and reason.
coming.subtitleTraces: Langfuse-backed traces: every prompt, tool call and token count for each answer you receive.
coming.subtitleEvals: Golden-dataset evaluations — faithfulness and context-recall scores with CI quality gates.
coming.subtitleSettings: Provider configuration: LLM endpoint, embedding model, Qdrant collection and reranker.
coming.subtitleAdmin: User management with roles and access scopes.
